string.text: Player-only visual detection. Scales stock visibility, then zeros acquisition below a pose cutoff. Optional smooth remap starts accumulation at 0 just above the cutoff. Does not change NPC-vs-NPC vision, sound, or AlifeTactics. Tip: turn off AlifeTactics Disclosure "Turn on the shooter" so wounds do not fake seen-class.
Multiply stock visibility (light x velocity x range falloff) before cutoffs. 0-1.
If scaled visibility is below this while standing (or any non-crouch/prone pose), NPCs gain no visual acquisition. Higher = stealthier.
Same gate while crouching (not prone). Higher = stealthier.
Same gate while prone (crouch + accel / True Prone). Higher = stealthier.
When on, visibility just above the cutoff starts at 0 and climbs linearly to 1 at full visibility. When off, scaled visibility is used as-is once above the cutoff.
Small bottom-center gem showing your scaled visibility (brighter = more visible).
Show last scaled vis, active cutoff, and output on the actor message line.
